purpose: Requested QF_LIA default promotion, not a global tuning study
selection: Existing frozen 200-case hybrid QF_LIA selection; retained content hashes and expected answers
order: Each slot rotates the four profiles; sequential same-core measurement. One pass only: no machine-noise or stable-runtime claim.
model_validation: Every successful native SAT row, separate after whole timing array; native180s/Dolmen60s
qualifier: Generated/real-seed correctness gate must be complete and audited before timing launch.

loss_followups.criterion: Completed native pairs where NEW loses a solve versus OLD or CUBE; two extra paired rotations, no pooling into200-caseheadline.
loss_followups.model_policy: After all primary and followup timing arrays, replay every successful native SAT row separately.
